# The bus on the highway

<!-- STEP id="speed-up" -->
A bus moves at 36 km/h. In m/s, that is 36 x 1000 m / 3600 s = 10 m/s. The driver presses the accelerator for 10 s, and the velocity rises to 54 km/h = 15 m/s.

a = (15 - 10) / 10 = 0.5 m/s², in the direction of the velocity.

<!-- STEP id="brake" -->
Later the driver sees an obstacle and brakes. The bus stops in 5 s.

a = (0 - 15) / 5 = -3 m/s². The minus sign means the acceleration is opposite to the velocity.
